_about: Copy to config/private.json (gitignored) and fill in. Says which analytics every splash gets and how its tracking ID reaches the build. Facts only: a browser tracking ID is public, but never put a secret here or in a site.

analytics.skill: The skill that wires and verifies this provider, e.g. openpanel-analytics. Load it before writing the component.
analytics.env_var: The build-time variable holding the tracking ID, e.g. OPENPANEL_CLIENT_ID
analytics.id_lives_in: Where that ID is stored for a GitHub Pages build: a repo Variable (not a Secret), passed in the workflow's build step
analytics.client_naming: How to name the provider-side site or client, e.g. splash_<repo>
analytics.allowed_origin: The origin to allow on the provider side, e.g. https://lossless-group.github.io (origin only, no path)
